title: English Garden Bounty Bowl
description: A bulgur wheat salad bowl with asparagus, broccoli, broad beans, beetroot, tomatoes and radishes, finished with a wholegrain mustard dressing.
ingredients: 1 quantity Wholegrain Mustard salad dressing (see p.210)
small handful of parsley leaves, finely chopped
steps: Cook bulgur wheat per package instructions; cool.
Steam or simmer asparagus, broccoli and broad beans for 3 minutes; rinse under cold water and drain.
Divide bulgur between 2 bowls; arrange watercress, beetroot, tomatoes, asparagus, broccoli, broad beans and radishes around each bowl.
Dry-fry sunflower seeds until starting to colour.
Drizzle dressing over; scatter cress, parsley and toasted sunflower seeds.
notes: Leftover radishes can be quick-pickled using the method on p.142.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
